suggested_issue_title: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript: package.json main and types point to dist/index.js, which npm run build does not create
suggested_issue_body:
## Summary

`package.json` sets `"main": "dist/index.js"` and `"types": "dist/index.d.ts"`. With `rootDir` set to `./src` and the entry module at `src/aspose/threed/index.ts`, `tsc` writes `dist/aspose/threed/index.js`; no `dist/index.js` exists. Importing the package by name (or `require('.')` from the repository root) therefore fails.

## Environment

- Revision `66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4` (default branch `master`)
- Node.js v22.23.3 and npm 10.9.9 (Docker image `node:22-slim`, Linux); the same results on Windows with Node.js v22.11.0
- `npm install` and `npm run build` complete without errors; verified on 2026-10-16

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
npm install
npm run build
node repro.js   # repro.js holds the script below, saved in the repository root
```

```js
const fs = require('fs');
const pkg = require('./package.json');
console.log('main:', pkg.main, 'exists:', fs.existsSync(pkg.main));
console.log('types:', pkg.types, 'exists:', fs.existsSync(pkg.types));
try { require('.'); } catch (e) { console.log(e.message.split('\n')[0]); }
```

## Expected

`require('.')` loads the library, and `main` and `types` name files that exist after `npm run build`.

## Actual result

```
main: dist/index.js exists: false
types: dist/index.d.ts exists: false
Cannot find module '<repository>/dist/index.js'. Please verify that the package.json has a valid "main" entry
```

## Where in the repository

- `package.json:5-6` (`main`, `types`)
- `tsconfig.json:9-10` (`outDir` `./dist`, `rootDir` `./src`) and `src/aspose/threed/index.ts`
